top_choice_rationale: P005 supplies the strongest organizing mechanism here: explicit statistical relations connect irreversible fluctuations and work histories to thermodynamics beyond mean response. I retain Evans, Jarzynski and Crooks provisionally for this bounded discovery, without inferring complete credit from the supplied trio. Relation-specific preparations, reverse dynamics, work definitions and rare-trajectory sampling must support decisive tests, and the joined early-fluctuation/later-work chronology must justify the allocation. DMFT is my strongest alternative for a controlled dynamical explanation; the clock invention and circuit-QED interaction regime are equally eligible forms of fundamental physics. Force microscopy opens valuable structural access, but its common sensor-and-tip invention and calibrated interpretation remain more entangled. The leading cases merit an award rather than P000.
